messages:
Ravi: Quick heads-up — Acme renewal draft asks for a 12-month dedicated pool pledge. They're proposing 2200 inference-rps (p50 ~70ms). Need ops + billing to validate cost and risk. Can we run SLA stress + billing sim this week?
Maria: Added to ops queue. Do we have a recent tail-spike histogram for that workload?
Ravi: Pushed logs to s3://redwood-acme/telemetry/2026-03/trace-2200qps.json. Observed p95 ~610ms at sustained 2200 rps, with packet/GPU GC bursts. p50 68ms.
Aj: Can we model with 20% headroom? If we commit 2200 + 20% = 2640, cost increases ~14% but reduces throttles.
Kevin: I can run a bench in eu-west1 with the same image. Will spin a 3-node pool (A100x8) and replay load.
Ana: Billing note — reserved price tiers: 12-mo reserved pool gives ~18% discount vs on-demand. Overage billed at 1.2x on-demand for excess QPS.
Zoe: Product would prefer a canary window + automatic burst for 2hr/day. That pushes us toward a smaller commit + burst option.
Tim: SRE: need regional-failover sim. If eu-west1 loses one node, can the pool still hit 2200 qps? Prob not without burst capacity.
Ravi: Proposed test matrix: baseline, +20% headroom, +regional-failover. Command I used locally:
```bash
./tools/commit_sim.py --pool acme-eu --target-qps 2200 --duration 30m --pattern mix --save results/2200.json
```
Kevin: Ran baseline locally, attaching output snippet:
```
results/2200.json: p50 72ms, p95 610ms, p99 1.4s, dropped 0.8%
cpu_util: 82%, gpu_mem: 67%
```
Aj: Those drops are concerning. Need to check batching window and KV cache hot-shots.
Maria: Ops run plan:
- reproduce Kevin's run
- toggle batch_window {auto, 20ms, 50ms}
- toggle kv_cache size (default, +30%)
- run billing sim for 12mo/24mo

Ana: Billing sim snippet:
```python
# calc expected invoice
python scripts/calc_commit_cost.py --tenant acme --qps 2200 --term 12 --headroom 1.2
# -> EST: reserved $72k/mo vs on-demand $98k/mo, overage risk 3-5% monthly
```
Ravi: Can someone own the canary + billing slide for Monday? Sales needs numbers.
Kevin: I'll own the bench + ask infra for extra A100s. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ana: I'll run the billing numbers across commit levels (2200/2640/1800) and include overage scenarios.
Zoe: I'll propose the canary policy: 2-week canary at 60% commit, automatic fallback to hosted if errors >1.5% over 15m.
Tim: Add a test for network egress throttles — last time region NAT limits caused spikes.
Ravi: Timeline summary: bench + stress (Kevin) by EOD tomorrow; ops config matrix (Maria) by Friday; billing sims (Ana) by tomorrow afternoon; canary policy draft (Zoe) Monday morning. Ping me for blockers.
ops-bot: scheduled bench-job 2167890200 for kevin with timeout 90m.
Kevin: Got it, starting now.
